source.title: U.S. DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated 1 July 2026)

versions.notes: Long-standing rule; in force before this date. Earlier history is not modelled — effectiveFrom is the modelling baseline, not the date the rule was enacted. Georgia rate $5.15 applies only to employers of 6+ employees not covered by the FLSA; FLSA-covered employers must pay $7.25 (federal pack).

coverage.notes: No statewide paid sick leave accrual law; no official Georgia source stating this explicitly was verified, so sick_pay.paid_sick_leave_accrual is omitted. The Georgia Family Care Act (use of existing sick leave for family care) is not modelled. No daily overtime.
